project: AI-Based Early Detection of Forest Fire and Smoke from Satellite / Camera Images
institution: School of Computer Science Engineering and Information Systems, VIT

1_nasa_modis.name: NASA MODIS Collection 6.1 Active Fire Dataset
1_nasa_modis.source: NASA EOSDIS FIRMS (Terra and Aqua Satellites)
1_nasa_modis.channels: 4 µm (brightness) & 11 µm (bright_t31) Thermal Infrared, Fire Radiative Power (MW)

2_nasa_viirs.name: NASA VIIRS 375m Collection 2 Active Fire Dataset
2_nasa_viirs.source: NASA EOSDIS FIRMS (Suomi-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 Satellites)
2_nasa_viirs.spatial_resolution: 375 m (3x higher spatial fidelity than MODIS)
2_nasa_viirs.channels: I-Band 4 (3.74 µm) & I-Band 5 (11.45 µm) TIR, Fire Radiative Power (MW)

3_environmental_weather_fwi.name: UCI Forest Fire Weather Index (FWI) & Meteorological Dataset
3_environmental_weather_fwi.purpose: Provides environmental fire risk factors to the Multi-Model Risk Fusion Engine

4_camera_surveillance.name: Wildfire Camera Surveillance Fire & Smoke Dataset
4_camera_surveillance.source: HPWREN (High Performance Wireless Research and Education Network) & DeepQuest AI
4_camera_surveillance.format: YOLO Bounding Box Annotations (.txt) + RGB Images
4_camera_surveillance.purpose: Ground and aerial camera surveillance inference for early plume detection

5_distractors_clouds_fog.name: Environmental Distractor Benchmark Dataset (Clouds, Fog, Dust, Haze)
5_distractors_clouds_fog.purpose: Explicit negative training to eliminate false positives from ambient clouds or morning fog

6_satellite_multispectral_datacubes.name: Multi-Spectral 27-Band NetCDF Datacubes (.nc)
6_satellite_multispectral_datacubes.dimensions: 10 Temporal Days x 64 km x 64 km Spatial Patches
6_satellite_multispectral_datacubes.purpose: Spatial-Temporal ConvLSTM + Attention wildfire spread prediction
